assets.gate_reason: TW7 town stone roads: the existing exact road identities (GRASS_ROAD_STONE, FLOOR_ROAD_STONE, Shatur COBBLESTONE) currently draw the brown forest dirt-road tile in towns. One opaque stone-slab road floor master; rules unchanged (walkable floor). No waiver.
assets.native_name: GRASS_ROAD_STONE / FLOOR_ROAD_STONE / COBBLESTONE town stone road
assets.scope: Static towns only (townKind): Derth, Last Hope, Zigur, Angolwen and Gates of Morning roads, Shatur lake bridge. Other zones keep the forest road tile.

references.note: Native town road: an old paved stone road through the town. Keep the laid-stone road identity but make it large pale flat slabs instead of dark cobbles, and fill the whole square.
Accepted board floor master (TW6): flat overhead matte finish, low contrast, scale, upper-left light and the calm printed-board surface. Not its woven material or tan palette.

grid_contract.movement: Walkable; no movement rule, no speed bonus.
grid_contract.interaction: None; shops are trap-layer doors on building walls, never on the road.
grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed floor material; the exporter crops 2 checker parities (parity 1 about 12% darker).

prompt_fields.subject: A town road paved with large flat dressed stone slabs seen from straight above: rectangular and square flagstones of pale warm limestone in an irregular ashlar bond of mixed sizes (about three to five slabs across the square), tight narrow joints with a little packed grit, tops worn smooth. Calm and even.
prompt_fields.palette: Pale warm grey-beige and light buff stone with faint ochre and cool grey variation between slabs; joints a soft mid brown-grey, never black. Light overall: clearly lighter than green grass and than dark stone building walls; warmer and more clearly slab-jointed than a plain grey stone plaza floor.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as a flat, walkable paved road that game pieces stand on: a few large light slab shapes with thin joints; low internal contrast so characters stay readable; distinct from grass by its pale warm stone colour and from walls by being much lighter; no dark cobbles.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead paving filling the whole square with even density and a non-directional slab pattern; no kerb, border, centre line, gutter, grass verge, deep crack, hole, step, object or shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Walkable road only. Paint no kerb, wall, step, stairs, grate, drain, puddle, hazard, marking, character, symbol or text.

assets.gate_reason: TW7 crop fields: FIELDS1-4 in Zigur and Angolwen are native today; their rules are exactly plain grass. One opaque crop-field floor master that must read as walkable ground. No waiver.
assets.scope: Zigur (town-zigur) and Angolwen (town-angolwen) FIELDS1-4 only; the un-tiled FIELDS and every other zone stay as they are.

references.note: Native cultivated field: a vegetable plot of tilled soil with rows of young crops. Keep the tilled-rows-with-seedlings identity but much lighter, flatter and filling the whole square.
Accepted board floor master (TW6): flat overhead matte finish, low contrast, scale, upper-left light and the calm printed-board surface. Not its woven material or tan palette.

grid_contract.movement: Walkable; exactly the rules of plain grass (no movement rule, no speed bonus or penalty).
grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed floor material; the exporter crops 2 checker parities (parity 1 about 12% darker).

prompt_fields.subject: A cultivated vegetable plot seen from straight above: light, dry, finely tilled brown earth in straight evenly spaced shallow furrows running left to right, with low young leafy seedlings (small round green leaves, ankle high) along each ridge; flat ground, nothing standing up.
prompt_fields.palette: Warm light-to-mid brown tilled soil, medium fresh green seedlings, a few ochre dry clods. Mid value overall, about as light as green grass or slightly lighter, never dark; not grey stone; no black shadows between rows.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as flat walkable farmland, soft alternating brown and green stripes, clearly different from plain green grass by the stripes and brown soil and from a pale stone road by colour; low contrast so characters stay readable; the crops look short and flat, never like a hedge, bush, fence or wall.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead field material filling the whole square; about seven furrows across the square, parallel to the top edge, evenly spaced and reaching all four edges; no field border, fence, path, stone, tool, scarecrow, water or cast shadow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Walkable cultivated ground only, the same rules as grass. Paint no fence, hedge, tall stalks, trellis, water, hazard, character, symbol or text.
